chunk_text:
The plant shall be provided with a process control system based on redundant configuration for safe and reliable operations with high availability. The design, control philosophy, redundancy concept, grade of integration, etc. will be subject to review, comment and approval by the Offtaker. The scope of supply shall include - but not be limited to - the following systems and components:
- Primary sensors, transmitters, actuators minimum equipment required shall be according to relevant IEC code or International Standards
- Plant control and monitoring system (DCS -Digital Control System) for CCR & Supervisory Control  and  Data  Acquisition  (SCADA)  for  the  Substation  and  other  Plant  packaged systems, including all necessary software licenses for the Plant with redundant operator stations and additional one operator / engineering station.
- The plant and control and monitoring system shall be designed to fulfill all Cyber Security regulations including HCIS requirements and international standards such as ISO 27000 series (especially ISO 27001,ISO 27002 and ISO 27019
- The network architecture shall be designed using quadrant segregation and will fulfill all requirements as per ACWA cyber security policy.
- Long-term  data  server  via  RAID  station  (Redundant  Arrays  of  Independent  Disks)  for central back management and archiving.
- Network with routers and switches
- Copper/FO-converters where applicable
- Plant monitoring system and performance calculation (at all design conditions).
- Settlement metering system including check meter shall be provided in line with the latest version of the Grid Code at the date of the Bid submittal.
- Hardware and software for Plant Accounting Settlement System (PASS)) including and other  requirements  (data  transmission,  Remote  control  from  LDC,  cybersecurity,  AMI integration) as defined by Offtaker.
- Internal communication systems (telephone, public address system, LAN/ WAN system)
- GPS-based clock systems
- All relevant BOP system like HVAC, Fire-fighting and Fire detection systems, CCTV and surveillance systems in accordance with the country local requirements i.e. HICS KSA .
- Ergonomic designed control room
- Field testing equipment
- Instrument workshop equipment.
